decoder.rule: For observed Busan tokens only: candidate = UInt16(byte07) | (UInt16(byte08) << 8), where stationToken is bytes05-08 and byte07/08 are its final two bytes.
guardrails: Keep the complete stationToken/locationCode as the stable raw fingerprint.
Do not interpret the candidate as a nationwide ID.

nationwideMobileNumberCollisionAudit.finding: Every observed numeric candidate has multiple nationwide mobile-number matches. Namespace by Busan mode and BusanBIS before joining.

bus.settlementIDFinding: Do not prefix 26 to the decoded number. It conflicts with exact ARS matches (e.g. raw 04001 is BIMS 미광마린타워, while 2604001 is absent; raw 01003 is BIMS 시민아파트 while settlement ID 2601003 is 당감동).

rail870.finding: 28/30 station tokens (250/256 rows) exactly match official station codes with WGS84 coordinates. Values 148 and 180 have no match in the 2021 or 2025 official Busan Metro station lists and should remain unknown.

observed877.inference: The token layout, Busan co-occurrence, and exact ordinal correspondence make 부산김해경전철 plausible: low16 1 -> official BG/B1 code 0101 사상; low16 4 -> 0104 공항. No primary source found tying KOTRIS/card mode 877 to operator BG, so do not label it as official or deterministic.

integrationRecommendation: Build lookup keys as `${transportModeCode}:${stationToken}`; preserve locationCode for audit.

For modes 601-618 only, derive candidateARS from the final two token bytes little-endian, zero-pad to 5 digits, and join only to valid official Busan BIMS ARS entries. Accept only exactly one Busan match.

For mode 870, use the same little-endian derivation as the official 3-digit Busan Metro station code; join to the collision-free 2021 station+coordinate dataset, then overlay newer names from the 2025 file except known code-quality errors.
Keep decoded values 148 and 180 unknown; show the numeric candidate and evidence status.
Keep mode 877 as observed/unknown by default. If the UI supports hypotheses, show BGL candidates 0101 Sasang and 0104 Airport with an explicit inferred badge and source links, never as confirmed.
Do not use nationwide ARS, BIMS stopID suffix, or 26-prefix joins: collision audits show they are unsafe.
